# DanmaChat – Fullscreen Live Chat Overlay & Danmaku for YouTube

Formerly named "YouTube Custom Chat & Danmaku".

> Free, open-source Manifest V3 browser extension (~37 KB) for Chrome-based browsers and Mozilla Firefox that adds a transparent, draggable live chat overlay and 60FPS DOM/WAAPI Danmaku scrolling comments to YouTube live streams and live chat replays.

## Quick Facts
- **Version:** 1.2.0
- **Author:** khanhnkq (https://github.com/khanhnkq)
- **License:** MIT
- **Chrome Web Store:** https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/youtube-custom-chat-danma/eapcgaoflonkgkhaeidekcnkaoniajad
- **Source Code:** https://github.com/khanhnkq/youtube-chat-enhance
- **Homepage (EN):** https://khanhnkq.github.io/youtube-chat-enhance/
- **Homepage (VI):** https://khanhnkq.github.io/youtube-chat-enhance/vi/
- **Privacy Policy:** https://khanhnkq.github.io/youtube-chat-enhance/privacy/

## Core Features
- **Transparent Floating Live Chat Overlay:** Displays YouTube live chat directly over the video in Fullscreen and Theater Mode while automatically collapsing the native side chat column.
- **Draggable, Resizable & Minimizable:** Drag anywhere inside the player, resize via the bottom-right handle, collapse into a compact `Live Chat` corner badge, and automatically restore clamped placement across reloads.
- **60FPS DOM/WAAPI Danmaku:** Scrolls live chat comments across the screen (Bilibili / Niconico style) using compositor-only transforms, collision-free track reservation, pause/resume video sync, sender avatars, emoji support, Super Chats, and member welcomes. Works even when Floating Chat is turned off.
- **Real-Time Styling:** 0–100% background opacity, font size controls, inline RGB/HEX color pickers for username/message/Danmaku text, dark outline stroke, shadow, scroll speed (4s–20s), and display area (Top 1/3, Top 1/2, Top 3/4, Fullscreen).
- **Performance Architecture:** 80ms batch IPC messaging (cuts postMessage overhead >90%), single-channel `chrome.storage.onChanged` sync, zero background blur overhead.
- **Privacy:** Only 2 permissions (`storage` and `https://www.youtube.com/*`). Zero analytics, zero ads, zero remote servers, `data_collection_permissions: ["none"]`.
- **Languages:** Built-in English and Vietnamese popup UI with keyboard navigation.
